name: PMKSY — Per Drop More Crop (Micro-irrigation)
name_mr: प्रधानमंत्री कृषी सिंचन योजना — प्रती थेंब अधिक पिक (सूक्ष्म सिंचन घटक)
summary: The MahaDBT page describes support for drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation. The page states assistance shares of 55% for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers, subject to the scheme's current component rules and approval.
benefit_summary: Official page states 55% for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers. This is not a guaranteed amount; eligible equipment, area limits, prior-benefit rules and approval apply.
source_facts: The page lists Aadhaar, 7/12 and 8-A records as eligibility requirements; a caste certificate is required for SC/ST applicants.
The page describes a 5-hectare benefit limit.
For an electric water pump, the page requires a permanent electricity connection and a recent electricity bill.
The page describes a 7- or 10-year restriction for repeat benefits on a survey number, depending on when the previous benefit was received.
After prior approval, the farmer must buy an eligible micro-irrigation set from an authorized seller, install it, and upload the bill within 30 days.
Documents listed on the page: 7/12, 8-A, electricity bill, purchase invoice and prior-consent letter.

document_items.label: Recent electricity bill (if using an electric water pump)
Invoice for the approved micro-irrigation set
document_items.stage: After prior approval; upload within the period stated on the official page

checks.label: Area limit stated on source page (up to 5 ha)
Permanent electricity connection for an electric water pump
Prior benefit on this survey number (time restriction applies)

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
summary: The MahaDBT page lists horticulture components including vegetable development, horticulture mechanization, protected cultivation and post-harvest activities. It also lists onion-storage infrastructure under post-harvest management. The applicable component must be selected and checked on the official portal.
benefit_summary: The official page lists multiple activity-specific assistance components. This demo does not reproduce a component-specific amount; check the current official benefit schedule before acting.
source_facts: The page requires Aadhaar, 7/12 and 8-A records; an SC/ST certificate is required for applicants in those categories.
The page states that the farmer or farmer group must have horticulture crops.
The listed documents include 7/12, 8-A, an SC/ST certificate where applicable, and a quotation or bill for the item/equipment.
The page lists many distinct components; conditions vary by component.

document_items.label: Quotation or bill for the selected item/equipment

name: State Agriculture Mechanization Scheme
summary: The MahaDBT page describes support for listed farm machinery and implements, including tractors, power tillers, equipment and post-harvest machinery. A farmer can receive support for one listed implement; repeat-benefit restrictions apply to the same implement.
benefit_summary: Financial assistance is listed for specified machinery and implements. Amounts vary by item and official benefit schedule; no amount is shown in this demo.
source_facts: The page lists Aadhaar and 7/12 and 8-A records as requirements; a caste certificate is required for SC/ST applicants.
The page lists machinery/implements such as tractors, power tillers, operated equipment, processing sets and post-harvest technology.
The page states that support is payable for one implement; a 10-year restriction applies to another benefit for the same implement.
The page lists quotation and inspection information, self-declaration and prior-consent as required documents.

document_items.label: Quotation and approved inspection report for the selected implement
Self-declaration
document_items.stage: As listed on the official page

checks.label: Prior benefit for the same implement (10-year restriction)
